title: Dealer Network & Sales Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake unifies dealer sales data, generates AI-powered next-best-action recommendations for 450 dealers, and automates personalized outreach — replacing fragmented CRM with unified intelligence

talking_points: National sales at 82% of target — ฿3.2B gap to close this quarter.
Northeast region underperforming: 67% of target. Bangkok on track at 94%.
Forty-seven dealers flagged for intervention — conversion rates dropping.

transition.line: Let's see what AI recommends for the underperforming dealers.

talking_points: AI generates personalized NBA for each dealer — incentive packages, inventory swaps, training focus.
Dealer D-0234 in Chiang Mai: recommend EV test-drive event based on local demand signals.
Cortex Complete writes the outreach email — personalized to dealer principal's communication style.
tabs.call_out: AI-personalized actions for 450 dealers — weekly refresh

transition.line: How do we know these recommendations work?

talking_points: ML.FORECAST projects 15% EV demand surge in Chiang Mai next quarter based on registration trends.
Current inventory allocation mismatched — Chiang Mai has 90-day pickup stock but only 15-day EV stock.
Dynamic Table auto-generates reallocation recommendations daily.
show: Show demand forecast by region and model
tabs.call_out: Demand forecast drives inventory allocation — daily auto-refresh

transition.line: Now let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Kittisak asks: 'Which dealers should receive Q4 incentive packages?'
Cortex Analyst: Returns ranked list with impact projections — top 20 dealers projected to close ฿180M gap.
Switch to advisor: 'Draft incentive proposal for Northeast region' — generates complete brief.
show: Type: 'Dealers needing incentives ranked by gap-to-target'
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + strategic advisory

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Personalize/Cortex Complete generates NBA; SES/Notification Integration delivers it.
Thailand's 450 dealers sell 800K vehicles/year. This optimizes the entire distribution network.
tabs.call_out: AI-driven sales — from insight to outreach in one platform

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for automotive sales intelligence in Thailand.
